These are cameras that operate using the High Definition Composite Video Interface (HD-CVI) video transmission format. Using these cameras, you can generate stunningly clear video footage up to 1080p resolution. A key benefit of HD-CVI is that it is relatively new technology. This means you can connect your cameras over longer distances than with older technology, such as HD-SDI, without bandwidth or latency issues typical of older formats. If you have large premises or outbuildings, this makes installation all the more easier. We feature several styles of camera to meet the demands of your application, including dome, turret, and bullet shapes. The majority of these have advanced functionality, such as smart infrared night vision, digital wide dynamic range, privacy masking, motorised lenses, anti-vandal camera housing, IP66 weatherproofing for outdoor use, and more (depending on the model).
